Class CanvasGraphicsAdapter

Namespace
BOOSECoreApp.Core.Adapters
Assembly
BOOSECoreApp.dll

Provides an adapter that exposes a CanvasApp as an IGraphicAdapter and ICanvasProvider for executing drawing commands.

public class CanvasGraphicsAdapter : IGraphicAdapter, ICanvasProvider

Remarks

This class allows commands to interact with a CanvasApp via the standard graphics interface used in BOOSE applications.
